summary: FD_TC_215_3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim NOT Opened � EU Country (Belgium) � Manual Handoff
title: 3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim NOT Opened � EU Country (Belgium) � Manual Handoff
description:
Validates that when a claims company submits, the passenger has NOT opened a claim, and the country is EU-eligible (Belgium), the system proceeds to manual handoff.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Claims Company. Passenger has NOT opened a claim. Country of origin: Belgium.
